name: velora-audit-cleanup
description: Daily DB TTL cleanup — sessions, CriticalWriteEvent, ChatMessage, IdempotencyRecord, StockMovement, CashMovement, PushSubscription, PaymentIntent, RateLimitBucket, WebhookSecurityIncident (one sequential run)

name: velora-rule-alerts
description: Fires BusinessRule time-based triggers every 5 min (ART-anchored, 1h catch-up window, idempotent by ruleId+slot+empId)

name: velora-daily-summary-push
description: End-of-day owner push notification (20:00 ART = 23:00 UTC)

name: velora-daily-summary-chat
description: End-of-day sales summary injected as a ChatMessage (20:00 ART = 23:00 UTC); dedup'd by clientMessageId

name: velora-anomaly-scan
description: Stock velocity alert scan every 2 hours — flags fast-moving products below reorder threshold

name: velora-week-patterns
description: Weekly day-of-week pattern analysis (Planner Level 2) — runs Sunday 00:00 ART = 03:00 UTC

name: vertex-search-reindex
description: Daily reindex of per-tenant product catalogs into Vertex AI Search

name: customer-embedding-refresh
description: Daily pgvector embedding refresh for Customer table (semantic recall)

name: velora-event-retry
description: Retries stale AgentEventLog rows (pending >5 min or error past 10-min cooldown) — batch 50 per run; aligns with PENDING_STALE_MS=5min constant in event-retry-cron.ts

name: velora-first-sale-nudge
description: 24h re-engagement nudge — if owner completed onboarding (firstSalePromptShown=true) but has no Sale ≥24h after T4, injects a warm nudge ChatMessage and sets firstSaleNudgeSent=true (once-only)

name: velora-mp-health-check
description: Daily MP OAuth token health-check (09:00 ART = 12:00 UTC) — pings /users/me per active MpConnection; marks expired on 401 and notifies owner via WhatsApp

name: velora-promesa-vencida
description: Daily check at 09:00 ART for PaymentIntents with metodo=promesa + estado=confirmed + promesaExpectedAt < now. Nudges owner per PI via ChatMessage (owner_only) + push. Idempotent: clientMessageId=promesa-vencida-{id}-{YYYYMMDD}.

name: velora-push-cleanup
description: Monthly push subscription tombstone GC — deletes expired=true rows with updatedAt older than 90 days (1st of month 04:00 ART = 07:00 UTC)

name: velora-mp-payment-reconcile
description: Recovery cron — every 1 min (Stripe-canonical 2026 cadence). Polls MP for stale (>5min) or reconcileFastTrack=true intents and enqueues velora-payment-confirm Cloud Task. Worst-case recovery 6 min. Idempotent via mp-confirm-{piId} task name. Ref: docs.stripe.com/webhooks/process-undelivered-events

name: velora-idempotency-prune
description: Frequent stuck-pending idempotency prune — every 5 min (ART-anchored). Fixes M-1: deletes IdempotencyRecord rows with status=pending and updatedAt older than 5 min so a stuck row blocks AFIP emit retries for at most ~5 min instead of ~24h. The daily audit-cleanup is unchanged (belt-and-suspenders fallback).
